assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chemically induced proximity that hijacks the ubiquitin-proteasome system to degrade targets once thought undruggable; a genuinely new pharmacological modality, now spanning heterobifunctional PROTACs and molecular glues, with clinical-stage degraders.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and developed the PROTAC concept; Handa's identification of cereblon as the thalidomide target explains molecular glue degraders. Ciulli, Gray and others made major later advances, so a three-person cut is contestable and the glue/PROTAC split is not fully settled.
assessment.maturity: Over two decades of independent confirmation and many clinical programs, but approvals are still pending, so clinical vindication is incomplete; the mechanistic foundation is nevertheless solid.
uncertainties: Whether credit should centre on PROTAC conception or on the molecular glue/cereblon discovery
Absence of an approved degrader drug as of the evidence supplied
Competing claims from Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto and others

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the enabling delivery technology for siRNA and mRNA medicines; the chemistry of pKa-tuned lipids and self-assembly into stable particles solved the central delivery problem and had enormous societal impact, notably in COVID-19 vaccines.
assessment.attribution: The credited list is large (six) and credit is split between ionizable-lipid design, formulation processes and early liposome work; Cullis, Anderson and MacLachlan represent the lipid design and formulation lineage, while Langer, Hope and Madden contributed significantly. Allocation is hard and partly a patent-entangled question.
assessment.maturity: Validated by approved siRNA drugs and billions of vaccine doses, so maturity is exceptional. The 2023 Medicine prize recognised the nucleoside modification side, leaving the delivery chemistry open.
uncertainties: Who made the decisive contribution among six credited names
Possible perception of overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize
Patent disputes may complicate assessment of priority

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors convert one base into another without double-strand breaks, an elegant example of protein and nucleotide chemistry engineering that expands precise genome editing, with first clinical use in sickle cell and cardiovascular disease.
assessment.attribution: David R. Liu led the invention; Komor and Gaudelli were first authors of the cytosine and adenine base editors respectively. Kondo and Nishida independently developed related deaminase fusions, which weakens an exclusive claim, but a Liu-centred award is defensible.
assessment.maturity: Roughly a decade old; broad adoption and early clinical data, but long-term safety and off-target profiles are still being mapped, and genome editing was recognised in 2020, which may make timing less urgent.
uncertainties: Fit to the chemistry category versus a CRISPR follow-up to 2020
Long-term clinical safety unknown
Kondo and Nishida's parallel contribution

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Shokat's tethering strategy against the KRAS G12C switch-II pocket turned a target considered undruggable into a drug-discoverable one, leading to approved covalent inhibitors; his earlier chemical genetics of kinases with analog-sensitive alleles also shaped the field.
assessment.attribution: Shokat is the clear originator of the KRAS G12C covalent approach; the supplied credit lists only him, giving a clean single-laureate configuration, though industry teams carried it to approval.
assessment.maturity: Clinical approval supplies strong independent confirmation; resistance and durability limits are still emerging but do not undermine the discovery.
uncertainties: Whether the prize would be shared with the kinase chemical genetics work or with the industry optimisation teams
Clinical benefit is incremental in some tumours

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Biomolecular condensates and liquid-liquid phase separation reorganised how we understand intracellular organisation, with physical chemistry principles applied to cellular compartments; this resonates strongly with my own interest in designed peptide assembly.
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman showed liquid-like P granules; Rosen demonstrated multivalent-interaction phase separation in reconstituted systems. Pappu and Mittag contributed theory and sequence grammar, so selecting three omits important contributors.
assessment.maturity: Rapidly growing but still contested: physiological relevance, condensate definitions and some artefacts remain debated, and translational payoff is early.
uncertainties: Debate about in vivo relevance and definitions
Fit of a cell biology result to the chemistry prize
Credit among Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen, Pappu and Mittag

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing converts single-molecule chemistry into an electrical signal and became a commercial DNA/RNA sequencing technology; relevant to biosensor science as a molecular-recognition platform with practical impact.
assessment.attribution: Deamer and Branton conceived reading polynucleotides through a pore; Bayley developed protein pore engineering and stochastic sensing. Kasianowicz demonstrated the first experiment and Akeson the enzyme-controlled translocation, so priority is contested.
assessment.maturity: Technology is widely used and independently validated, including long-read sequencing, though accuracy and the specific founding claims remain argued.
uncertainties: Priority dispute between conceptual proposal and experimental demonstration
Kasianowicz and Akeson being left out of a three-person slate
Possible overlap with the sequencing field

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native chemical ligation and expressed protein ligation allow chemical total synthesis and semisynthesis of proteins, including modified proteins; this is a foundational enabling method that closely relates to peptide chemistry.
assessment.attribution: Kent and Dawson developed native chemical ligation; Muir extended it to expressed protein ligation. Danishefsky, Brik and Liu made major later contributions.
assessment.maturity: Well established for about 30 years with independent applications; recognition is overdue, but the field's impact is mostly as a tool.
uncertainties: Breadth of impact beyond specialist protein chemistry
Credit allocation between synthesis and semisynthesis

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetic code expansion allows site-specific incorporation of noncanonical amino acids into proteins in living cells, creating a general tool for protein engineering and biophysical probes.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established orthogonal aaRS/tRNA pairs for noncanonical amino acids; Chin extended to multiple codons and organisms; Wang contributed early eukaryotic and mammalian applications. Mehl and Yokoyama have contributions that lie outside the three selected.
assessment.maturity: Mature and widely used, but few clinical outcomes; timing is reasonable but less urgent than candidates with approved therapies.
uncertainties: Impact on practice versus tool status
Priority among Schultz, Chin and others
